title: FAQ Page
prompt: Build two expandable FAQ items using native details and summary elements.
objective: Provide clear questions and concise answers for two FAQ items.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: details, summary, headings.
hints: Summary is the visible label; each details element owns its disclosure content.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Summary is the visible label; each details element owns its disclosure content. Required structural evidence: <details>, <summary>.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
